# id: # For a JavaScript or TypeScript project. Run the watchdog from inside the repo.

claim in plain words: no .only left in a test, which silently skips every other test
the lock file is committed, so everyone installs the same versions
check (must exit 0): test ! -f package.json || ls package-lock.json pnpm-lock.yaml yarn.lock bun.lockb 2>/dev/null | grep -q .

claim in plain words: no .env file is tracked by git
if you use a .env, an example of it exists for other people
fewer than 20 files in src/ carry a TODO or FIXME
check (must exit 0): ! git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || test "$(git grep -lE 'TODO|FIXME' -- 'src/*' 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -lt 20
